svg.text: Since Sep 28, 2026 · the reviewer prompts still change most weeks
Changes reviewed and PRs merged, per week
Real bugs still open at each judge pass, by age
Judge tokens per pass, by stage
Fan-out audit: does a fix need making elsewhere too · Convention check: does new code copy a helper or sit in the wrong place · Result review: does a change make a result wrong
* beside a hollow point or bar: a week only partly logged, or under 10 sessions · * on its own: no tokens logged · tokens include cache reads
c: a real bug is one the verify agent called fix or decide (or found already fixed), or a stranded commit · fixed = gone at that pass, the first time since it was flagged
Data through Nov 10 · 244 sessions · how it is counted: docs/ai-assist/AGENT_RECORD.md
